==Behind the scenes==
Synthplate appeared in ''[[Crisis on Cloud City (adventure book)|Crisis on Cloud City]]'', a [[1989]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Christopher Kubasik]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Crisis" />
